verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a Custom Integrations capability for creating and mapping custom resources from tools it has no native integration for. Raw data can be pushed via an API endpoint, and Secureframe then normalizes, maps and tests it. This sits on a documented REST API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference and a backwards-compatibility versioning policy. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom-integration pushes work in practice, explicit documentation that pre-computed test results or evidence artifacts (rather than raw resource data) can be pushed directly, and a separately downloadable spec URL.
